aaron rodgers.note: Rostered (claimed by Def Not Kira on waivers this morning) - no longer available.

alvin kamara.note: RotoBaller's #1, but the role is a three-way committee: 28-of-74 snaps (38%) with rookie CJ Donaldson matching him and Kendre Miller mixing in, 50 combined rushing yards vs ATL - and Kamara (back) missed Wednesday practice. Committee trap, not a lead back.

antonio williams.note: 73% route rate, 8 targets, 12.6 expected points as WAS's WR2 with McLaurin (hamstring, Q) sidelined - and the QB fear is gone with Jayden Daniels back off the injury report.

brenton strange.note: 7-of-8 for 95 yards in Week 4; the role is real, but JAX spreads targets (BTJ, Meyers, Washington, Tuten) and the TD hasn't come yet.

brian robinson jr..note: 15 touches for 67 yards and 3 TDs in Week 4's rout of New Orleans; 10+ touches in three straight games. ATL feeds its backs (Penix has thrown 45 passes in two starts) - stash for role growth, not startable yet.

chris bell.note: MIA garbage offense - excluded by rulebook.

cyrus allen.note: KC rookie (20% rostered) who drew camp hype; Rice (hamstring, multi-week) and Thornton (dislocated ankle, out indefinitely) could force a real route share - but KC is on bye in Week 5 and he's unproven. Deep stash only.

darius cooper.note: 7 targets (most of any Eagle) on 90% of snaps in Week 4 with 2 TDs, but it's a 33% three-way split with Wicks and Lemon and the role dies when DeVonta Smith (hamstring, Q) returns.

devaughn vele.note: 84%+ snaps for NO but 63% owned with no verified target volume to justify the roster spot. Skip.

dohnte meyers.note: 90% routes and 9 targets as CIN's injury fill-in with Chase (concussion) and Higgins (adductor) iffy, but the talent check says no - Kenny's explicit opportunity-without-talent example. Someone else can chase the MIA matchup.

emanuel wilson.note: 60% of snaps and 76% of backfield opportunities in Week 4 (21-81-1 rushing, 3-39-1 receiving, 25.5 half-PPR) as SEA's lead back with Price (chest) on IR to Week 8 and Charbonnet (ACL recovery) ruled out Week 5. Caveat: 3.6 YPC tempers it, and Charbonnet is practicing with a 'prominent role' promised on return - bid a 2-4 week starter, not a season answer.

jacoby brissett.note: Locked in as ARI's starter (LaFleur said no to a change) and DET allows the most fantasy points to QBs - but he's 2-13 as ARI's starter and just threw 3 INTs (55.2 rating). Streamer only.

jakobi meyers.note: 10 catches on 12 targets with a TD over his last two games as JAX's starting perimeter WR; PPR flex floor.

jaylen wright.note: MIA garbage offense - excluded by rulebook.

jordyn tyson.note: IR stash with a possible Week 7-9 return; talented rookie with multi-week runway once active.

keaton mitchell.note: Led LAC's backfield in touches (15 for 63 yards) in Week 4, but it's a dead-even three-man split (26/25/25 snaps with Hampton and Vidal) in a winless offense - boom-bust, not a volume bet.

kendre miller.note: 19-of-74 snaps in NO's three-way split behind Kamara and Donaldson; touchdown-dependent flex at best. Skip.

kenyon sadiq.note: 56% owned and Yahoo's #2 TE add, but no verified route/target edge on a bad Jets offense - don't pay for the name.

keon coleman.note: Career game in Week 4: 6-of-7 targets for 116 yards and a TD on 78% of snaps (31-of-40 routes); 14-of-16 catches this season and the 2nd-most routes on BUF. D.J. Moore (shoulder) may sit Week 5 - rental window plus real third-year breakout trajectory.

khalil shakir.note: Most routes on BUF, 7-of-8 for 82 in Week 4, 6+ targets in 3 of 4 games - the high-floor Bill, though 42-62% owned so rarely available.

kirk cousins.note: Rostered (won by DOOM $6-to-$3 on waivers this morning) - no longer available.

malik washington.note: Yahoo's top sub-50% WR add, but MIA garbage offense - excluded by rulebook.

michael mayer.note: 73-78% route share the last two weeks and 8-of-9 for 82 yards in Week 4 - LV's clear second pass-catcher behind Bowers with genuine every-week TE2 usage.

mike gesicki.note: TD in 3 of 4 games with Chase (concussion) and Higgins (adductor) out and a soft MIA matchup in Week 5; 8 catches on 10 targets for 115 yards. But 3 TDs on 8 catches is touchdown-dependent and the role shrinks when the WRs return - one-week rental.

mike washington jr..note: Top one-injury-away RB stash behind Jeanty in LV; pure handcuff until the backfield opens.

ollie gordon ii.note: RotoBaller's #3, but MIA is a garbage offense - excluded by rulebook.

roman wilson.note: 6.0 targets/game looks fine until you see 19 or fewer routes in each of the last two games with Pittman playing - no real role. Skip.

romeo doubs.note: 6-of-9 for 58 yards and 2 TDs in Week 4 (12/203/2 on the season) as NE's starting flanker; targets rising weekly in a Drake Maye offense that just went toe-to-toe with Buffalo. A.J. Brown (ankle) is also on this roster, so target competition tightens when Brown returns.

t.j. hockenson.note: 13-of-13 for 119 yards (tied career high in catches) on a 40% target share (83% snaps) with Jefferson (ankle) out and Oliver (biceps) on IR; 22/195 on the season in an every-down role. The catch: MIN ranks dead last in total yards, and the value evaporates the moment Jefferson returns.

tank bigsby.note: FanDuel's #2, but headed to IR for core-muscle surgery (out ~6 weeks, per Rapoport) - there is no role to add.

tory horton.note: Snap share declining three straight weeks (31% to 17%) - the coaches are telling you the role is shrinking. Skip.

tre' harris.note: 77% snap share on the year (93% in Week 4), 13 catches for 209 yards on 21 targets as LAC's starting flanker; McConkey (foot) aggravated it again. Startable while McConkey is out, but the path closes on his return - rental, not stash.

tyler allgeier.note: Listed RB1 on ARI's Week 5 depth chart and handling goal-line work, but Jeremiyah Love's snap share is climbing (55% since Week 3) while Allgeier's fell to 36% - TD-dependent handcuff, not a flex.

tyler higbee.note: 13-129-1 on 17 targets over two games with a 77% route rate while Ferguson (ankle, IR) and Parkinson (shoulder) are out - legitimate TE streamer.

tyreek hill.note: Still a free agent targeting a November return from the multi-ligament knee injury; KC has reached out (Thornton/Rice injuries) but nothing is signed - ceiling stash only, and only with bench space to burn.

will shipley.note: 46% of snaps and 15 routes in Week 4 (6-23-0) after Barkley (hamstring, week-to-week) exited and Bigsby (core surgery) went to IR - the last man standing and the likely lead back Week 5 at Jacksonville. He's never topped 100 rushing yards in a season and PHI may promote Pierce/Blue for early downs, so this is a rental, not a breakout.

xavier worthy.note: Finally flashed in Week 4 (70 yards, doubling his season total) and KC's WR room is in triage - Thornton (dislocated ankle) out indefinitely, Rice (hamstring) multi-week. But KC is on bye in Week 5 and the passing game is struggling, so this is a role-growth stash, not a plug-and-play.

zach charbonnet.note: Practicing but ruled out for Week 5 by Macdonald; debut no sooner than Week 6-7. Bench stash only - doesn't dent Wilson's Week 5 value.
